name: Shiiku Sareru Mesu no Kouzu
source:
Deep in debt, two women end up losing their independence to even go to the bathroom. The same room where they had spent normal peaceful days with their husband turns into the stage for perverted sex play! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034169.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
两个女人债台高筑，甚至失去了去厕所的自主权。她们曾与丈夫一起度过平静日子的房间，变成了变态性爱游戏的舞台！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034169.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
